about: Reader-probe questions for the after-grill page. Each key and quote comes from grill.md; `answer` lists every correct choice.

questions.question: How many card columns does a 1512px-wide laptop show, and from which width are there three?

choices.c: Three columns; two only on phones

source.quote: Card grids use one column on phones, two up to 1919px, and three from 1920px.

questions.question: When does the year in the copyright line change?

choices.a: In the visitor's browser, on the first visit in a new year
choices.b: With the first build of the site in a new year
choices.c: When someone edits it by hand
choices.d: Never; the line carries no year

source.quote: Add the build year to the copyright; it advances on the first build of a new year.

questions.question: Which Episodes get Overview as their lead Tag?

choices.a: The intro Episode of the November 4 Event
choices.b: The intro Episode of the October 28 Event
choices.c: The first Episode of the October 23 AXEL Event, Onboard AI Every Time
choices.d: Every Episode in the November 4 Playlist

source.quote: Make it the lead Tag for the November 4 and October 28 intro Episodes, retaining **Agentic workflow** and their other Tags. Leave the October 23 AXEL Episode unchanged.

questions.question: What happens to the workflow Tag?

choices.a: Only its displayed name changes, to Agentic workflow
choices.b: Its displayed name becomes Agentic workflow and its stored ID becomes agentic-workflow
choices.c: It is removed from the intro Episodes

source.quote: Rename the `workflow` Tag and its stored ID to **Agentic workflow** / `agentic-workflow` throughout the site.

choices.a: The "Start with Episode 1" button is removed
choices.c: The Playlist's Episode links are removed
choices.d: Nothing; only the November 4 Event page changes

source.quote: Remove the “Start with Episode 1” button from every Event, leaving Playlist navigation intact.

choices.c: Whether the AXEL Event gets Overview artwork
choices.d: The German title of the November 4 Event
